description:
This week on VSRF Live, we’re honored to welcome a fierce defender of truth, freedom, and parental rights: Sam Sorbo.Show more Once a Hollywood actress and international model, Sam walked away from the spotlight to fight for something far more powerful: parental rights and educational freedom.
After studying biomedical engineering at Duke University, marrying actor Kevin Sorbo, and spending over a decade homeschooling their three children, Sam saw firsthand what most parents only suspect—our school system isn’t just failing kids; it’s conditioning them.
Now, she’s on a mission to help parents reclaim their rightful authority and raise resilient, free-thinking children—not compliant products of a system that begins shaping minds as early as preschool.
Today, Sam is leading a growing movement to restore parental authority and educational freedom. Through her books, her nationally recognized podcast The Sam Sorbo Show, and her work with Sorbo Studios and the They’re YOUR Kids Foundation, Sam empowers families to break free from the system and reclaim their role in shaping the next generation.
Join us live this Thursday for a powerful conversation on:
How government schools are eroding parental control
Why taking back your child’s education is the ultimate act of resistance
Real-world steps to restore your influence and reclaim your rights
The power and possibility of homeschooling
How to raise resilient, free-thinking children in a culture that demands conformity
📺 Tune in this Thursday at 7 PM ET / 4 PM PT live on Rumble and X
This is more than a conversation—it’s a rallying cry for parents, grandparents, educators, and anyone who refuses to hand their children over to a broken system.
Let’s reclaim what’s ours—because parents, not bureaucrats, should decide what’s best for their kids.
Donations are tax deductible and we need your support to continue our work into 2024. Or to text-to-donate, text VSRF to 53-555 Show less
